summary: Enhance your career with our Advanced Computer Skills Training Course designed for Office Administrators and Secretaries. Master essential tools and techniques.
lede: Advanced computer skills for office administration help professionals manage documents, schedules, data, and digital records accurately. Designed for administrators, secretaries, and executive assistants, the course develops practical workflows for Word templates and mail merge, Excel formulas and PivotTables, and Outlook scheduling. It also covers cloud collaboration, digital filing, secure sharing, phishing awareness, and introductory AI-assisted drafting and task shortcuts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for office professionals who manage documents, schedules, correspondence, data, and digital filing in fast-moving administrative environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with a desktop or laptop computer, keyboard use, and everyday office software navigation. Prior experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, or Google Workspace is helpful but not required beyond beginner level. A laptop is recommended for hands-on practice, and participants should be prepared to work with sample office documents, spreadsheets, email scenarios, and file folders during the course.
